follow-up time: From birth until death in infancy, or censorship at the end of the study period
cohort: Women aged 15-49 years who resided in Texas from 2011-2015 (n = 1,942,899)
finding: In two Texas counties with high prevalence of maternal chronic conditions, maternal marital status, education, multiple gestation, and caesarean delivery were significantly associated with infant mortality.
mod_finding: Caesarean delivery was significantly associated with infant mortality
